priya_csm: Quick check — OpalStream onboarding: saw tail latency spike around 10pm UTC last night, p99 jumped to ~1.8s (baseline ~0.45s). I want to propose a proactive tweak: route short-form chats to compact-int8 model variant + enable prefix/KV caching with TTL=30s. Any blockers?
owen_se: saw that in the console too. p95 stayed OK (~0.22s) but p99 drift is concerning. Do we have eval runs comparing compact-int8 -> quality on ops_smoke_v2?
priya_csm: not yet, that's part of why I'm pinging. Customer onboarding SLA is timeboxed — they hit 5M tokens/month; renewal signal low if latency persists. want minimal risk plan.
riley_dataops: I ran a quick eval overnight vs ops_smoke_v2: compact-int8 shows ~0.8% ROUGE drop on instruction-heavy prompts, but reranking queries unaffected. I'll paste the summary table in a sec.
redwood-deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: route-change/opalstream/compact-int8 -> 5% traffic for 4h (owner: owen_se).
jamal_sre: infra note — current Dedicated pool for this tenant is at 72% GPU utilization; 5% canary on compact-int8 should be fine. If prefix cache enabled, memory needs +1.2GB per replica. Need approval from infra quota.
owen_se: thanks @jamal_sre. If memory bump is ok we can do canary. On quality: riley, can you share a few failure cases where compact-int8 diverges? We can add fallback policy: if perplexity delta > 1.5x or match-rate drop > 2% then route to baseline fp16.
riley_dataops: pasted quick failures: 
```
- prompt: "Summarize policy for refund windows"
  baseline: clear bulleted list
  compact-int8: missed the timeframe sentence twice
- prompt: "Rewrite email: urgent outage"
  baseline: empathetic + checklist
  compact-int8: tone slightly terse
```
Overall autoscore delta: 0.8% on our eval; but a few edge prompts show differences.
ava_revops: note on renewal — account touched on latency in SLA call last week. If we can show a proactive ops plan (canary + revert rules + weekly eval), that'll materially reduce churn risk. I'll include this in renewal playbook.
priya_csm: proposed rollback/fallback plan: canary 5% 4h with metric gates: p99 increase > 10% OR eval-match drop > 1.5% -> auto-roll back. If canary passes, increase to 25% for 24h, then full. Agree?
owen_se: agree. I'll prepare the routing snippet and the canary config. Quick snippet below for the routing policy: 
```
route: opalstream.user.chat
variants:
  - model: gpt-compact-int8-v1
    weight: 0.05
    conditions: "request.tokens <= 256"
    on_failure: route_to: gpt-base-fp16-v2
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_s: 30
```
jamal_sre: I'll preemptively reserve +2GB on the pool and monitor OOM. Also setting an alert: `infra_alerts/opalstream_kv_mem > 1.5GB` to Slack.
tasha_prod: (from customer) appreciate the heads-up. can we make sure critical user journeys (billing, finalization flows) are pinned to baseline until canary passes?
priya_csm: good call — we'll add route override for billing flows: `route.tags contains "billing" -> baseline`
owen_se: I'll push the canary at 03:00 UTC after the config review, tagging @ava_revops and @jamal_sre. Will also attach eval artifacts.
ava_revops: I can join post-canary sync and add a short note for renewal owner. Nice proactive move :thumbsup:
priya_csm: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for actions. Next steps: owen to push canary, riley to attach eval gist, jamal to reserve memory, ava to update renewal playbook.
redwood-deploy-bot: canary deploy started: route-change/opalstream/compact-int8 at 5% (canary_id: c-9832).
